recommendation.thresholdSummary: Action threshold crossed: Severe Thunderstorm Watch with storms reaching the area during the evening commute
recommendation.explanation: A Severe Thunderstorm Watch runs from 2 PM to 10 PM. A line of storms is forecast to reach Kansas City between 4 and 6 PM with hail up to 1.5 in and gusts near 55 mph at the office, right as the evening commute begins. The morning and most of the workday stay dry, so the office can open on time; releasing employees by 2:30 PM gets them home before the storms arrive.
recommendation.whatCouldChange: Storms slowing to arrive after 6 PM would support normal hours. A Severe Thunderstorm Warning with confirmed damage, downed power lines, or a blocked route would support closing the office.

triggers.threshold: Watch or Warning during the evening commute

alternatives.note: Sends 70 employees home into large hail and 55 mph gusts at 5 PM.
Reasonable for the 51 telework-ready employees, but not required: the morning commute is dry.
Not supported: no damage, power loss, or blocked routes.

alerts.headline: Severe thunderstorms possible this afternoon and evening. Scattered large hail up to 1.5 inches and damaging wind gusts to 70 mph possible.
